alt: Review Exercise 1 · Q10: Salma invested Rs. 3,50,000 in a bank, which paid simple profit at the rate of 7 1/4 % per annum. After 2 years, the rate was increased to 8% per annum. Find the amount she had at the end of 7 years.

now.text: The step being explained right now.

ans.label: Last step
ans.text: The last step of the solution.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Principal }=Rs.3,50,000\\[5pt]&\text{Rate for the first }2\text{ years }=7\frac{1}{4}\%=\\[5pt]&\quad \frac{29}{4}\%\text{ per annum}\\[5pt]&\text{Profit for the first }2\text{ years }=\\[5pt]&\quad \frac{P\times R\times T}{100}\\[5pt]&\quad =\frac{3,50,000\times \frac{29}{4}\times 2}{100}\\[5pt]&\quad =Rs.50,750\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Working
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Rate for the remaining }7-2=5\text{ years}\\[5pt]&\quad =8\%\text{ per annum}\\[5pt]&\text{Profit for the next }5\text{ years }=\\[5pt]&\quad \frac{3,50,000\times 8\times 5}{100}\\[5pt]&\quad =Rs.1,40,000\end{aligned}\]

steps.title: Result
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Total profit }=50,750+1,40,000=Rs.\\[5pt]&\quad 1,90,750\\[5pt]&\text{Amount at the end of }7\text{ years }=\\[5pt]&\quad \text{Principal }+\text{ Total profit}\\[5pt]&\quad =3,50,000+1,90,750\\[5pt]&\quad =Rs.5,40,750\\[5pt]&\text{Salma had }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{Rs. }\mathbf{5,40,750}}\text{ at the end}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{of }7\text{ years}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(simple profit, principal unchanged).}\end{aligned}\]
